rationale.faithfulness: Clipping beats raw out of sample in 26-27/32 periods with a CI above zero, and the gain follows the random-matrix signature (grows with N/T, falls with training length; unfitted). The HH's stronger claim fails: clipping ties Ledoit-Wolf constant-correlation shrinkage (17/32 vs the best shrinkage). Talk room structure is erased by cleaning. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D2 E0 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A computable monitor rule from standard logs: forecast tomorrow's pair co-movement from a cleaned or shrunk matrix, not raw (about 10% lower error; 30% skill over a no-correlation forecast in content, ~0 in talk). It also tells an operator that pair-level content structure beyond one uniform mode is not persistent day to day. No lever.
